semantics.client_starts: Independent starts.csv records the client get-call point, including unfinished calls. Not server arrival; error_rate covers completed requests only.
semantics.window: Actual test-start through stop/drain/quitting; ramp and drain included.
semantics.rate: users is target concurrency; spawn_rate is users/s; task_rate is closed-loop tasks/user/s, one request/task, not guaranteed open arrival rate.
semantics.rps: Completed observed HTTP requests / actual monotonic test window seconds.
semantics.sql: Received SQL span attempts / same window; unknown responses counted separately. Excludes internal pre-ping and unreturned traces.
semantics.percentiles: Linear interpolation over raw response_ms, including failures. Original Locust rounded histogram stats retained separately.
semantics.history: Actual one-second completion bins, not Locust rolling history. Last bin may be partial.
semantics.locust_csv: Original history rates/percentiles are rolling; counts cumulative. Do not average percentiles.
semantics.mysql: Global Questions/Queries include monitoring, health and transactions. Delta/elapsed is instance statement rate, not business SQL QPS; reset on Uptime/counter decrease.
semantics.resources: psutil process-tree CPU/summed RSS; first CPU null. Docker CLI uses a separate VM/container scope. CPU may exceed100%; RSS may double-count shared pages.
semantics.timeouts: HTTP504, pool_timeout and transport timeout overlap; do not add as mutually exclusive failures.

limitations: Short ramp-inclusive exploratory run, not a capacity or reliable tail-latency claim.
Monitoring competes for pool capacity and issues SQL. Docker CLI sampling cadence is measured, not assumed.
Closed-loop users reduce offered throughput when requests slow; client start is not server arrival.
CPU intervals may cross window edges; resource observations have distinct process/container scopes.
